text:
Emma (Finance): PartnerGalileo flagged that their April Azure Marketplace invoice shows EUR totals that don't match the USD breakdown they received earlier. They say conversion and VAT handling looks off.
Hugo (Sales EU): PartnerGalileo expects gross in EUR with VAT shown separately. We sent USD CSV during signup; they reconciling to EUR bank payment.
Lars (Billing): Pulled invoice INV-2026-04-22. CSV snippet:
```
invoice_id,sku,charge_usd,vat_pct,converted_eur,conversion_rate
INV-2026-04-22,redwood.azure.gen,12000,0.20,10200,1.1765
```
Lars (Billing): Our conversion used rate 1.1765 (USD->EUR) but partner claims bank used 1.1890. Also VAT was applied on converted amount rather than on USD gross per local rule.
Sophie (Tax): For EU reseller billing, VAT should be computed on the local-currency net amount after conversion; however contract clause 4.2 says customer pays invoiced VAT only if provided. Need to check contract.
AccountingBot: Invoice note: currency_conversion_rule=FIXED_RATE_DAILY, vat_policy=APPLY_AFTER_CONVERSION.
Emma (Finance): Impact: EUR difference ~160 (due to bank rate) + VAT difference ~204. Partner expecting an explanation and a corrected VAT breakdown PDF.
Hugo (Sales EU): I'll send short note to Galileo acknowledging and request bank FX proof.
Lars (Billing): Action plan: 1) Attach detailed FX calc and VAT line to invoice PDF, 2) If partner provides bank rate proof, we can issue a goodwill adjustment for FX variance up to 200 EUR (per sales discretion), 3) Add a clarifying note to portal about conversion rates.
Sophie (Tax): Confirmed VAT calc method is fine per our standard, but presentation needs to match partner expectation. No tax refund required unless we reissue invoice.
Emma (Finance): Approve goodwill up to 200 EUR pending proof. Please queue INV-2026-04-22-R1 if needed.
AccountingBot: Action created: TICKET-INV-FX-1885123456 assigned to Billing.
Lars (Billing): Noted. Uploaded revised invoice with FX breakdown and VAT explanation. Waiting partner confirmation.
Hugo (Sales EU): Partner replied "OK to accept revised PDF, will pay as shown". Closing. :white_check_mark:
